verdict.rationale: Docs clearly show starting the server from the CLI (e.g. `llamafile --server --help`, connecting to http://localhost:8080) and running CLI-mode inference, but there is no explicit documentation of a dedicated 'stop' command or graceful shutdown mechanism—only implied process termination. Missing for 10: explicit stop/shutdown CLI command or flag, first-party doc on server lifecycle management, and independent confirmation of clean shutdown behavior.
